---
title: Snow Character Rig
description: Poseable Blender Studio human character with body and face controls
---

[Snow](https://studio.blender.org/characters/snow/v4/) is a stylized human
rig with IK/FK limb switches and layered face controls. The `:rig` target
fetches the Snow v4.2 archive. Extract it and open `Snow/snow_v4.2.blend`.
The custom rig interface uses Python embedded in the file.
